issue.title: v32.0: Connection to tor control port cannot be disabled
issue.body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [x] I have searched the existing issues

### Current behaviour

I noticed this log line after upgrading to v32.0: 

```
2026-10-29T02:34:01Z [warning] tor: Error connecting to address 127.0.0.1:9051
2026-10-29T02:34:01Z [warning] tor: Initiating connection to Tor control port 127.0.0.1:9051 failed
```

### Expected behaviour

I have not configured a tor control port, so I would prefer if Core did not attempt to connect to one.

My clanker tells me that this has been the behavior for years, and all that changed is the log level was changed to a warning.

I do have an onion address specified with `externalip`, and I would like to continue accepting incoming connections to that onion, but I would like to avoid using the tor control for this.

### Steps to reproduce

1) Run `bitcoind`
2) Observe logs

### Relevant log output

_No response_

Compiled from source
